notes.title: Gamescom Demo Available for a Limited Time!
notes.content:
Hey All! We were blown away by the amazing reception we received at Gamescom! 🎉 Thank you to everyone who stopped by to check out Roadlike and gave us such incredible feedback.

We have some exciting news for those who couldn't make it to the event: We're giving Steam users exclusive access to the demo of Roadlike for one week after Gamescom! 🚗💨 This is a special opportunity to get a sneak peek at what we've been working on.

Important Note: Roadlike is still a work in progress. You may encounter bugs or other issues as you play, and we appreciate your understanding and patience as we continue to develop the game. Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us, so if you experience any issues or have suggestions, please don't hesitate to let us know. You can press F1 at any time during the demo to open our feedback form!

How to Access the Demo:

[olist]
[*] Head over to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2953970/Roadlike/]Steam page[/url].
[*] Download the demo during the one-week access period.
[*] Enjoy the ride and let us know what you think!
[/olist]
We can't wait for you to experience Roadlike and hear what you think. Thank you for being part of our journey. See you on the road!

PS - you can access all of our socials and mailing list [url=https://linktr.ee/reliableplumbingservice]here[/url].

notes.title: Come play Roadlike at Gamescom!
notes.content:
Hey all! Some exciting news - we're going to hitting the road for Gamescom!

From the 21st to the 25th of of August, you can find us at the Indie Arena Booth, Hall 10.2 - F010g - E019 at Koelnmesse in Cologne. We'll have an arcade booth there (appropriate) and some exciting new unseen content that we will be showing to the world for the first time.

If you are in the area you can get tickets [url=https://www.gamescom.global/en]here[/url].
